name: Na Vezi
description: Vodiš kontrolnu sobu Guncati Televizije — planiraš nedelju (format, platforme, oprema, gost, off-grid budžet), pa izvodiš emisiju uživo dok signal, chat i baterija testiraju tvoje odluke u realnom vremenu.

modules.src/main.js: Bootstrap — wires macro→micro→meta petlju, RAF game loop, sve screen tranzicije
modules.src/config.js: GAME_CONFIG, EQUIPMENT (18 stavki), FORMATS (3), ACHIEVEMENTS (14), helper funkcije
modules.src/state.js: DEFAULT_STATE, loadState, saveState, updateState, migrateState, guest reliability helpers
modules.src/events.js: Event bus: on/off/emit, EVENTS tipovi (battery, signal, achievement, emisija_end...)
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API: ambient pad, on-air jingle, alarm blip, chat sounds, battery pulse, prestige fanfare
modules.src/input.js: initInput, onKey, offKey, onTap, onPointer, onSlider — keyboard + touch handlers
modules.src/render.js: DOM rendering: renderTopBar, renderSignalBar, renderOffgridMeter, renderTimer, renderChatUpdate, renderAlarm, renderEngagement, flashScreen
modules.src/ui.js: renderMainScreen, renderWeeklyBriefing, renderMacroPlanningScreen (5 koraka), renderPrestigeScreen, achievement toast
modules.src/share.js: shareHighlight (Web Share API + clipboard fallback), screenshotDashboard, buildHighlightText
modules.src/content/aforizmi.js: Pera Period aforizmi po outcome tipu (great/good/ok/poor), getAforizam, getOutcomeType
modules.src/content/chat-templates.js: 13+ chat template-a po tagu (hype/pitanje/kritika/podrska) po platformi, srpski slang, generateChatMessage
modules.src/content/gost-roster.js: 8 gosta (g1-g8) sa profilima, calcNoShowChance, resolveGostArrival, calcGostEngagementBonus
modules.src/macro/planning-session.js: 5-koračna sesija planiranja: startPlanningSession, nextStep/prevStep, getDraftPlan, lockInPlan
modules.src/macro/platform-allocation.js: setAllocation (proportional rebalancing na 100%), getAllocTotal, validateAllocation, estimateDrain
modules.src/macro/weekly-outcome.js: calcWeeklyRevenue, updateAudienceAfterEmisija (IG growth, TikTok spike/decay, YT retention), resolveWeeklyOutcome
modules.src/micro/alarm-generator.js: ALARM_CONFIGS (5 tipova), calcAlarmChance, tryGenerateAlarm, resolveAlarm, missAlarm, tickAlarms
modules.src/micro/alarm-escalation.js: Odvojen od generatora: resetEscalation, processEscalation (lanci između alarmova), processResolution, getEscalationBonuses
modules.src/micro/dashboard-state.js: initDashboardState, getDashboardState, updateDashboardState, tickTime, tickSignal, calcOverallEngagement, isEmisijaOver
modules.src/micro/emisija-resolver.js: resolveEmisija: signalUptime, batteryUsage, engagement, capitalDelta, highlights, calls state updaters
modules.src/micro/eq-minigame.js: startEqMinigame, updateEqValue, confirmEq (diff<=15=success), tickEqWindow, getEqSession, resetEqSession
modules.src/micro/offgrid-runtime.js: resetOffgridRuntime, calcCurrentDrain, tickBattery (LOW<35% CRITICAL<25% events), formatCapacityInfo
modules.src/micro/platform-curves.js: calcPlatformEngagement (IG growth, TikTok spike detekcija<120s, YT retention), hasTiktokSpike, formatEngagement
modules.src/meta/achievements.js: checkAllAchievements (14 achievement-a AC1-AC14), individual checkers, getAchievementList
modules.src/meta/prestige.js: isPrestigeAvailable (>=8 emisije), executePrestige (loyal core 15%, oprema ostaje), getNextPrestigeMult
modules.src/meta/reliability-tracker.js: getGuestReliability, getAllReliabilities, isGuestReliable — NIKAD se ne resetuje na prestižu
modules.src/ui/replay-screen.js: renderReplayScreen — highlights, aforizam, brand hook, share/continue dugmad
modules.styles/theme.css: CSS custom properties — kompletan Guncati color sistem (bg, signal, warn, critical, crt, offgrid, platforme)
modules.styles/base.css: Layout reset, screen sistem (.screen/.screen.active), tipografija, panel sistem, progress bars
modules.styles/ui.css: Sve UI komponente: dugmad, HUD, briefing, macro planning, micro dashboard, chat paneli, alarm overlay, prestiž
modules.styles/game.css: Animacije: CRT scanline, battery breathing (3 intenziteta), alarm pulse, on-air glow, signal drop flash, TikTok spike
modules.styles/tutorial.css: Tutorial CSS: .hidden-tutorial, .dimmed-tutorial, tutorial highlight pulse, banner, step indicator
modules.index.html: Ulazna tačka — CSS linkovi, html2canvas CDN, #app div, script type=module src=main.js
